message.thinking: We need gross amount of unrecognized tax benefits as of Dec 31 2024. The reconciliation gives balance at beginning and changes, but not ending balance. Compute: beginning 1,253 +33 -52 +30 -57 -3 =? 1,253+33=1,286; -52=1,234; +30=1,264; -57=1,207; -3=1,204. So ending balance 1,204 million. That's the gross amount. So answerable.
